answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity upfront, protocol-enforced. PRISM: each new account deposits a refundable bond sized to a share of last epoch's reward pool before submitting work. CEDAR escrows it for L epochs; withdrawal or identity reset restarts the lock, so each puppet re-pays the full deposit. VERTEX attestation: an agent is a vertex whose incoming edges are signed verdicts from peers whose own locks matured, so a fake edge costs a frozen identity. Marginal cost is linear: N sybils pay N bonds, wait N lockups, forfeit all N on a flag. Honest users pay one bond once.
